title: Shattergate Protocol
description: A hard-edged tactical shooter where every bullet obeys destructible-cover physics and squads coordinate through a live ping-callout system. Shattergate Protocol pits eight-player fireteams against shifting objective maps that collapse mid-round. Built for players who want their gunfights to have consequences.

title: Loom of Embers
description: A sprawling narrative RPG about a guild of relic-menders stitching together a fractured empire one commission at a time. Branching dialogue and a reactive crafting system mean no two playthroughs assign blame the same way. Praised for its slow-burn character writing.

title: Redshift Arena
description: A 60-player battle royale set on a shrinking orbital ring where gravity itself becomes a weapon late in the match. This deluxe edition unlocks the full seasonal cosmetic vault and a private-lobby toolkit. Fast rounds, brutal verticality.

title: Ironclad Doctrine
description: A grounded grand-strategy title about logistics, supply lines, and the slow attrition of industrial-age warfare. Ironclad Doctrine rewards patient players who'd rather starve an enemy out than storm the gate. Deep modding support keeps its community active years after launch.

title: Harvest Hollow
description: A cozy farm-and-town sim where every villager keeps a memory of what you gave them. Harvest Hollow blends seasonal crop cycles with a gentle relationship system and a surprisingly deep fishing minigame. Great for unwinding after a long day.

title: Hollow Choir
description: A first-person horror game set inside a decommissioned radio observatory where the emergency broadcast never stopped. Hollow Choir leans on sound design and slow dread rather than jump scares, though it has a few of those too. Short, unsettling, and hard to put down.

title: Velocity Drift: Underground
description: An arcade street-racing series entry built around a live-tuned drift physics model and a nightly rotating circuit. Velocity Drift: Underground's career mode has you climbing crew rankings across a fictional coastal city. Couch co-op and split-screen included.

title: Fracture League
description: A fast, stylized team sport that mixes basketball footwork with grapple-hook traversal across vertical arenas. Fracture League ships with a full franchise mode and cross-play ranked seasons. Easy to pick up, deep enough to master.

title: Barrenwake
description: A punishing open-world survival game set in a salt-scoured badland where water is the real enemy. Barrenwake's base-building leans functional over decorative, and its day-night cycle genuinely changes what's hunting you. Not for the faint of heart.

title: Crimson Fold
description: A 2.5D fighter with a roster of sixteen origami-inspired combatants and a surprisingly technical parry-cancel system. Crimson Fold's rollback netcode has made it a fixture on the competitive circuit since launch. Deep tutorial suite for newcomers.

title: Knotwork
description: A minimalist puzzle game about untangling literal knots of light using rotation and reflection mechanics that get delightfully devious by the final chapters. Knotwork's soundtrack is entirely generative, shifting with your solve speed. A weekend-sized gem.

title: The Lantern Road
description: A hand-painted point-and-click adventure following a lamplighter's apprentice across a fog-choked mountain pass. The Lantern Road favors atmosphere and environmental puzzles over combat entirely. A quiet, melancholic story told in about six hours.

title: Null Signal
description: A big-budget military shooter with a fully destructible campaign and a 32-player warfare mode spanning land, sea, and orbit-drop insertions. Null Signal's engine tech has become a bit of an industry talking point. The current flagship release from Halfmoon Digital.

title: Thistledown
description: A tiny narrative walking-sim about a retired lighthouse keeper cataloguing the last blooms of a dying garden. Thistledown runs about ninety minutes and asks for nothing but your attention. A quiet debut from a two-person studio.

title: Warden of the Vault
description: A dungeon-crawling RPG about a disgraced knight guarding a vault that shouldn't exist, fighting through procedurally-remixed floors that punish greed. Warden of the Vault's gear-risk system means every extra chest you open raises the stakes. Deep itemization for loot fans.

title: Paperclip Kingdom
description: A tongue-in-cheek economy-builder about running an office-supply empire that slowly, absurdly, conquers the world. Paperclip Kingdom's tech tree is one long escalating joke that somehow still functions as a genuinely tight optimization puzzle. Cheap, weird, and easy to sink hours into.

title: Gravewind
description: A survival-horror throwback set in a quarantined fishing village where the tide brings something back every night. Gravewind leans hard into fixed-camera tension and deliberately clunky combat that forces you to think before fighting. A love letter to genre classics.

title: Skyferry
description: A gentle exploration game about piloting a rickety cargo airship between floating trade posts, delivering packages and eavesdropping on the small dramas of each stop. Skyferry has no fail state, just a world that keeps drifting whether you hurry or not.

title: Last Light Brigade
description: This year's flagship co-op shooter, dropping four-person fireteams into a collapsing city grid against a swarm-based enemy AI that adapts to your squad's tactics. Last Light Brigade shipped with cross-platform play and a full season-one roadmap already public.

title: Circuit Eleven
description: A precision-focused sim-racer with eleven fictional circuits modeled down to curb geometry and tire-wear physics. Circuit Eleven's career ladder is unforgiving but its telemetry tools are a dream for setup tinkerers. Wheel support is excellent out of the box.

title: Mossgrave
description: A co-op survival game set in an overgrown research station reclaimed by an aggressive, spore-driven ecosystem. Mossgrave rewards careful base defense over aggression, with a contamination meter that punishes reckless exploration. Best played with a full squad.

title: Kingdom of Tin
description: A tactics-RPG about a miniature kingdom of tin soldiers defending their toybox world from a spreading rust plague. Kingdom of Tin's grid combat is deceptively deep, and its permadeath option turns every battle into a real gamble. A cult favorite among tactics fans.
